queries: WITH per_exam AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e."aCL IgM" AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(acl_igm) AS mean_igm FROM per_exam), deviations AS (SELECT pe.ID, pe.SEX, pe.acl_igm, pe.acl_igm - o.mean_igm AS deviation FROM per_exam AS pe CROSS JOIN overall AS o), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation FROM deviations WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX) SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm AS "aCL IgM", d.deviation, d.deviation - s.average_deviation AS excess_deviation FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.average_deviation ORDER BY excess_deviation DESC LIMIT 10;
